title: Judge blocks first state law that would have banned prediction markets
summary: Menendez wrote: Specifically, it appears that whether the Minnesota statute is expressly preempted turns on whether the state law attempts to regulate trades in event contracts that qualify as “swaps” within the meaning of the CEA [Commodity Exchange Act].
